name: AgencyAnalytics
summary: Client reporting and dashboards built for marketing agencies: aggregate 85+ marketing platforms into white-label dashboards and automated reports, with per-client KPI goals. White-labeling on every plan.
best_for: marketing agencies that need white-label client reports from 85+ integrations — automated, on-brand and hands-off
skip_if: you're a solo operator with a couple of data sources, or you want rock-solid single-dashboard KPI tracking — Databox or a lighter tool may fit better
honest_knock: Cost scales linearly with clients — great at 5, pricey at 50+. The most-cited complaint is connector reliability: data sources disconnect and the platform doesn't always flag the failure clearly. Solo or small-data setups get little value from it.

plans.name: Everything your agency needs
plans.includes: one rate with every feature unlocked — unlimited data sources, reports, staff and client users; you pay per client on your roster, so a 50-client agency pays $1,000 a month

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: One published rate: $20 USD per client / month billed annually, with no clients included in the base, so cost scales directly with your roster (a 25-client agency pays $500/mo; past that it is a quote). Month to month is $25 per client: the card never prints it, but the page's own schema.org block publishes an AggregateOffer with lowPrice $20 and highPrice $25, which is exactly the advertised "Save 20% annually". Add-ons on top: Rank Tracker $41.67/mo per 500 keywords, AI Tracker $20.83/mo per 250 credits. Past 25 clients the vendor quotes instead of publishing (re-verified 2026-09-11).
